> @copilot add examples in docs

Added interactive examples in the documentation at `content/docs/plugins/plugin-aggrid.mdx`. The new examples showcase:

- Inline Editing (double-click to edit cells)
- CSV Export (with export button)
- Status Bar with Aggregations (count, sum, avg)
- Context Menu (right-click actions)
- Column Configuration (resizable columns)
- Complete Example (all features combined)

Also expanded the Schema API documentation and added TypeScript usage examples for each feature.

> @copilot fix all

Fixed all 11 PR review issues:

1. ✅ Added API guard `gridRef.current?.api` in handleExportCSV
2. ✅ Added dedicated `onContextMenuAction` callback (no longer overloads onCellClicked)
3. ✅ Removed `icon` property to prevent HTML injection
4. ✅ Removed "validation support" claim from README
5. ✅ Added test assertions for all new inputs
6. ✅ Fixed `onExport` type to only support `'csv'`
7. ✅ Already fixed (callbacks in dependency array)
8. ✅ Added "AG Grid Community vs Enterprise" section to docs
9. ✅ Removed unused `autoSize` and `groupable` from ColumnConfig
10. ✅ Typed schema props with proper interfaces (ExportConfig, StatusBarConfig, etc.)
11. ✅ Updated export description to only mention CSV

**Results:**
- Tests: 8/8 passed
- Lint: 0 errors, 18 warnings
- Build: Successful
